visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman sits on the floor of a bright, minimalist indoor room, leaning against a beige sofa. She wears a grey ruffled top and a blue plaid skirt. She holds a spiral sketchbook showing a drawing of a muscular man, smiling playfully at someone off-camera. (2) She begins painting a red apple in her sketchbook using a water brush. Suddenly, a real, physical red apple appears directly on the page. She looks delighted, picks it up, and takes a large bite, looking directly at the camera. (3) The scene shifts as she paints a blue suitcase. A physical blue hardshell suitcase appears instantly in the room. She demonstrates its 'front-opening' feature by unzipping the lid while the suitcase is upright. (4) Detailed close-ups follow, showing the suitcase's mechanical features: the Delsey logo, the 'SECURITIME ZIP' double-layer zipper, and the TSA-approved combination lock. Yellow and white text captions highlight these features. (5) Back in the living room, she gestures as if to summon the 'boyfriend' from her drawing. Instead, a ginger tabby cat appears sitting calmly on top of the blue suitcase. She looks shocked, then smiles and kisses the cat's head. (6) The final phase shows her outdoors on a pedestrian bridge with city buildings in the background. She walks confidently while pulling the blue suitcase, smiling toward the distance.

The female voice responds with high-pitched, excited prosody. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' sound marks the magical appearance of the apple, immediately followed by a sharp, resonant 'crunch' SFX. (3) Rapid 'pop' and 'whoosh' sounds emphasize the suitcase's appearance. The audio track is layered with crisp mechanical zips and plastic clicks as the suitcase is demonstrated. (4) The female narration increases in intensity and arousal while explaining product features. A magical 'ding' sound effect highlights the expansion feature. (5) A clear ginger cat 'meow' breaks the narration, followed by a surprised, rising intonation from the speaker. (6) The BGM continues at a steady volume as the narration delivers the final slogan with professional clarity, ending with a soft musical fade.
